01 / The challenge

What the job asks of your van.

Larger organisations need graphics that follow brand guidelines precisely and stay consistent as vehicles are replaced. We work from your brand guide and keep a master design for every vehicle type. Whether you need fleet livery design, pool van signwriting or lease vehicle branding, the layout has to work on your vehicle as it really is.

01

Brand guidelines

Colours, logo spacing and typefaces must match exactly.

02

Constant replacement

Leased vehicles come and go. New ones need to match.

03

Many models

Cars, small vans and large vans all need the same look.

02 / What to include

What your van must say.

  • Company logo, to brand guidelines
  • Website or service line
  • Fleet or vehicle ID
  • Any safety or compliance markings

Not sure what to include? Our guide to what to put on a work van walks you through it.

Before you book

Good to know.

Can you work to our brand guidelines?

Yes. Send your guide and we will match colours, spacing and typefaces.

Will graphics damage leased vehicles?

Quality vinyl removes cleanly from sound factory paint. We will advise on removal at the end of the lease.

Can you keep designs on file?

Yes. We keep approved templates so new vehicles can be matched quickly.
